description: Discard a launch waiting in the Agent Inbox, like its Discard button. Nothing is created in Meta. The saved build stays (ads_delete_build removes it). Launches that already started cannot be discarded. ads_edit_cancel handles edit suggestions.

buildId.description: Saved build ID of the waiting launch, e.g. build_abc123...

title: Discard a Waiting Launch
